datasets.name: Open Images V7
datasets.license: Annotations: CC BY 4.0; images: listed as CC BY 2.0
datasets.description: Approximately nine million images with image-level labels, object boxes, segmentation masks, visual relationships, and localized narratives.
datasets.accessNote: Verify the license of each source image before reuse.

datasets.name: COCO
datasets.license: Dataset terms and per-image Flickr licenses apply
datasets.description: A standard benchmark for object detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, and image captioning in complex everyday scenes.
datasets.accessNote: Review COCO terms and each source image license for the intended use.

datasets.name: Docmatix
datasets.description: A multimodal dataset for visual question answering over document images and PDFs, useful for document-understanding research.
datasets.accessNote: Review the dataset card and source-document considerations before training.

datasets.name: FineWeb
datasets.license: ODC-By 1.0; Common Crawl terms also apply
datasets.description: A large cleaned and deduplicated English web corpus designed for language-model pretraining, with smaller samples available.
datasets.accessNote: The full corpus is very large; begin with a sample and review documented bias and content limitations.

datasets.name: Mozilla Common Voice
datasets.description: Community-contributed multilingual speech datasets for automatic speech recognition and language research.
datasets.accessNote: Dataset versions and available languages change over time; select the required release and locale.

datasets.name: LibriSpeech
datasets.description: Approximately 1,000 hours of segmented 16 kHz English read speech derived from public-domain audiobooks.
datasets.accessNote: Multiple train, development, and test archives are available separately.
